name: A Chinese figure by a doorway in a stone wall
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a low stone wall rising to  enclose a doorway at the centre; against the wall a Chinese man leans, his pails and carrying pole beside him.
